## Hypothesis

We tested relaxed gates in the SHOTGUN_SCALPER strategy focusing on winning regions via parameter sweep (1458 combos). The goal was to improve edge capture on J's winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) while minimizing losses on loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07). However, the top keeper shows negative edge_capture (-36.0), indicating it underperforms baseline on anchor days by losing more on losers or capturing less on winners.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when volume ratio exceeds 1.2 (current bar volume > 1.2 × 20-bar average). Exits at: 
- Premium stop-loss: -30% (stop_premium_pct=-0.3) 
- Premium take-profit: +50% (tp_premium_pct=0.5) with chandelier profit-lock arming at +50% gain 
- Time stop: 10 minutes (time_stop_min=10) 
Strike selection: 2 OTM (strike_offset=2) for puts context. Chandelier arms at 50% gain (chandelier_arm_pct=0.5) to trail winners.
